name: Bachelor of Nursing
notes: CAO code KN-H-BN1. Campus: Howard College. School of Nursing and Public Health. APS 30 (excl. LO). 2026. Only first-choice applications considered. Leads to registration as general nurse, psychiatric nurse, midwife and community health nurse. International applicants need USAf evaluation (full matric exemption), FWMP letter, SANC registration, and passport/study permit or refugee status. Compulsory clinical placements outside Durban at the student's own cost. No late applications. Technical Mathematics not listed.

name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB)
notes: CAO code KN-M-MBC. Campus: Medical School (Nelson R. Mandela School of Medicine). APS not used (p.22 lists 'N/A'): minimum 60% in each of Mathematics, Physical Sciences, Life Sciences and English, with a 65% aggregate; ranked on the average of six subjects (incl. those four and two languages, excl. LO; Maths Paper 3 not substituted). Only current-year Grade 12 candidates considered in the NSC category; upgraded matric results not accepted. Pre-selection: 70% of Grade 12 seats allocated on Grade 11 final and Grade 12 mid-year results; final places depend on maintaining performance in the final exams. Places subject to target groups set by the College Board. Mature applicants with a year or more of a Science/Health Science degree with outstanding results considered. SADC applicants from countries without a medical school apply via their ministries. School of Tomorrow examination not eligible. Closing date 30 June 2026; no late applications. Mathematical Literacy not accepted. Technical Mathematics not listed.
